title: MobileDeviceAppRegistration - Data API
description: Represents the details provided in a mobile device registration event from an app that uses the Engagement Mobile SDK. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

DatetimeInDevice.description: The date and time of the registration event, based on values provided by the device.

DeviceModel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeviceModel.description: The model of the device that’s being registered, such as iPhone 17 or Google Pixel.

DevicePlatform.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DevicePlatform.description: The operating system of the mobile device, such as iPhone OS or Android.

DeviceSystemToken.description: A unique token that represents the mobile device. The push notification service (such as Apple Push Notification service or Firebase Cloud Messaging) uses this token to deliver messages to the device.

DeviceSystemTokenHash.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeviceSystemTokenHash.description: A hash of the device token.

DeviceTimezone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeviceTimezone.description: The time zone that the device is located in when the registration event occurs.

DeviceVersion.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeviceVersion.description: The version or model number of the device.

Deviceid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Deviceid.description: A unique identifier for the mobile device.

Eventid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Eventid.description: A unique identifier for the registration event.

IsBackgroundRefreshEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsBackgroundRefreshEnabled.description: Indicates whether the device gives permission for the app to receive updates while it’s in the background. The default value is false.

IsBluetoothEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsBluetoothEnabled.description: Indicates whether Bluetooth is enabled on the device. The default value is false.

IsDst.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDst.description: Indicates whether the device’s locale observes daylight saving time (DST). The default value is false.

IsLocationEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsLocationEnabled.description: Indicates whether the device has location services enabled for the app. The default value is false.

IsPushEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPushEnabled.description: Indicates whether the device has push notifications enabled for the app. The default value is false.

Locale.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Locale.description: The locale string for the device, such as en_US or ja_JP.

MobileAppName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MobileAppName.description: The name of the mobile app, as configured in Setup.

MobileAppVersion.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MobileAppVersion.description: The version number of the mobile app that generated the registration event.

MobileAppid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MobileAppid.description: A unique ID that represents the mobile app.

PartyIdentificationName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartyIdentificationName.description: The name of the party identifier for identity resolution rules.

PartyIdentificationNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartyIdentificationNumber.description: The ID used for identity resolution comparisons.

PartyIdentificationType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartyIdentificationType.description: A string that provides additional information about the type of party identifier used, such as Driver License or SSN.

RegistrationDatetime.description: The date and time when the registration event occurred.

Registrationid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Registrationid.description: A unique ID for the registration event.

SdkVersion.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SdkVersion.description: The version of the Mobile Engagement SDK that the app uses.
